    Convex pieces of a simply connected category are simply connected #

    Let A be a countable, interval-finite ray category without oriented cycles, chain-bounded with cancellation, in which every cocycle is a coboundary. Then every cocycle on a finite convex set D is a coboundary on D (isCoboundaryOn_of_global; Fischbacher 4.1(b), Bretscher–Gabriel 2.6–2.8, Bongartz, A criterion for finite representation type, 2.3): extend it along an exhaustion of A by finite convex hulls (exists_extend_cocycle) to a cocycle on A, which is a coboundary.
